## Writing style -- apply to ALL research text editing and drafting
Full guide: `C:\Users\rich\OneDrive - Danmarks Tekniske Universitet\JR\AI_auto\literature\Reference_Papers\STYLE_GUIDE.md`
Target register: Einstein (1905), Akerlof (1970), Kahneman & Tversky (1979), Ioannidis (2005).

**Do:** economy (cut every word that adds no force); concrete before abstract; active voice + first person plural (We show, We define); transitions with logical force (This implies, It follows that); one logical load per sentence; consistent terminology -- no synonym rotation.

**Cut immediately:** filler openers (It is worth noting that, It is important to note that); hedging (may potentially, could possibly, one might argue); meta-commentary (In this section we show that, We now turn to); AI-isms (delve into, showcase, leverage, robust, nuanced, paradigm, facilitate); inflation (highly significant, very important); wordiness (in order to -> to; due to the fact that -> because; utilize -> use); filler transitions (Furthermore, Additionally, Moreover).
